before.requirement: Retain boundary markers for surviving text and remove the marker before a control stripped by STRIPCC.
before.reason: The before normalizer strips negative boundary markers whenever STRIPCC is active, so it does not support this tuple.

source_evidence.quote:
/** Strips and/or convers control characters.
   *
   * NLF-sequences are transformed into space, except if one of the
   * NLF2LS/PS/LF options is given. HorizontalTab (HT) and FormFeed (FF)
   * are treated as a NLF-sequence in this case.  All other control
   * characters are simply removed.
   */
  UTF8PROC_STRIPCC   = (1<<9),
  /**
   * Performs unicode case folding, to be able to do a case-insensitive
   * string comparison.
   */
  UTF8PROC_CASEFOLD  = (1<<10),
  /**
   * Inserts 0xFF bytes at the beginning of each sequence which is
   * representing a single grapheme cluster (see UAX#29).
   */
  UTF8PROC_CHARBOUND = (1<<11),

after.requirement: With CHARBOUND and STRIPCC, retain boundary markers for surviving text and remove the marker before a stripped control.
after.reason: The changed normalizer supports both marker actions. Mapping forwards its options through decomposition and reencoding, but the fixed harness never supplies both flags to one operation. Its calls all consume the original input, so they cannot form the equivalent two-step route.

claims.reason: The same marker-retention and control-marker-removal tuple is assessed against the same old harness. It was unsupported before and is supported but unreachable through that harness after the change.
